annotations.title: Remove an integration from an agent

description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Remove an integration from an agent

Unassigns an integration from a voice agent, so the agent can no longer call any of its tools. The integration itself is untouched and stays available to assign elsewhere. The reduced tool set is pushed to the voice engine after the row is removed; if that push fails the request returns 502 and the integration is already unassigned locally but may still be callable until a later change syncs. This endpoint takes no request body.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

integrationId.description: Numeric identifier of the integration whose assignment is being changed. This is the integration id, not the assignment id.
